THE RECONSTRUCTION, RENDERED

Small aircraft.
Studio light.

Our Air65 II Racing model, with soft lighting, clear propellers and close-up detail. A digital studio portrait, made directly from the editable 3D model.

FROM REST TO ROTATION

Watch it spin up.

Ten seconds: still, accelerating, at speed, then back to rest. The propellers and motor bells rotate together; the airframe stays in place.

The peak of 60,394 RPM comes from BETAFPV’s bench sample for the Racing 0702 30000KV motor and GF1207 three-blade propeller. The ramp timing is chosen for the animation.

At high speed, a camera sees a soft blur. In the 3D Explorer you can adjust RPM, orbit the model and slow time to see the blades move.

OPEN THE PROJECT

Keep the editable original.

The studio scene, animated Blender project and full-resolution PNG are available with the release. The repository contains the JSON settings, rendering scripts and validation notes.

Studio release & downloads ↗How the motion is made ↗

Independent reference-based recreation; no affiliation with BETAFPV. Some model surfaces are estimated. The studio model retains the current assembly, including its unplugged battery display pose. Interactive blur is a lightweight visual approximation; the video uses integrated Blender renders. Neither is a flight or thrust simulation.
